QNUM=1
def guard_rendered(docs,namespace):
    versions={"ServiceAccount":"v1","Pod":"v1","PersistentVolumeClaim":"v1","Service":"v1","Deployment":"apps/v1","HorizontalPodAutoscaler":"autoscaling/v2","Ingress":"networking.k8s.io/v1","PodDisruptionBudget":"policy/v1"}
    allowed_kinds={1:{"ServiceAccount","Deployment"},2:{"Deployment","HorizontalPodAutoscaler"},3:{"Ingress"},4:{"Pod","PersistentVolumeClaim"},5:{"Pod"},6:{"Pod"},7:{"Pod"},8:{"PodDisruptionBudget"},9:{"Service","Deployment"},10:{"Deployment"}}[QNUM]
    podkeys={1:{"containers","serviceAccountName","automountServiceAccountToken"},2:{"containers"},4:{"containers","volumes"},5:{"containers","securityContext"},6:{"containers","imagePullSecrets"},7:{"containers","nodeSelector","tolerations"},9:{"containers"},10:{"containers"}}
    containerkeys={1:{"name","image","command"},2:{"name","image","command","resources"},4:{"name","image","command","volumeMounts"},5:{"name","image","command","securityContext"},6:{"name","image","command"},7:{"name","image","command"},9:{"name","image","ports"},10:{"name","image","command"}}
    seen=set()
    for d in docs:
        k=d["kind"];assert k in allowed_kinds and d["apiVersion"]==versions[k]
        assert set(d)<={"apiVersion","kind","metadata","automountServiceAccountToken" if k=="ServiceAccount" else "spec"},"extra rendered resource fields"
        m=d["metadata"];assert m["namespace"]==namespace
        assert set(m)<={"name","namespace"}|({"annotations"} if QNUM==6 else set())
        ident=(k,m["namespace"],m["name"]);assert ident not in seen;seen.add(ident)
        if k=="ServiceAccount":continue
        s=d["spec"]
        if k=="Deployment":
            assert set(s)<={"replicas","selector","template"}|({"strategy"} if QNUM==10 else set())
            assert set(s["template"])=={"metadata","spec"} and set(s["template"]["metadata"])=={"labels"}
            p=s["template"]["spec"]
        elif k=="Pod":p=s
        else:
            allowed={"Service":{"type","selector","ports"},"PersistentVolumeClaim":{"accessModes","storageClassName","resources"},"HorizontalPodAutoscaler":{"scaleTargetRef","minReplicas","maxReplicas","metrics"},"Ingress":{"ingressClassName","tls","rules"},"PodDisruptionBudget":{"minAvailable","maxUnavailable","selector"}}
            assert set(s)<=allowed[k]
            continue
        assert set(p)<=podkeys[QNUM],"extra Pod behavior not requested"
        assert len(p["containers"])==1
        c=p["containers"][0];assert set(c)<=containerkeys[QNUM],"extra container behavior not requested"
        assert c["name"]==("worker" if QNUM==2 else "web" if QNUM==9 else "app")
        assert c.get("securityContext",{}).get("privileged",False) is False
        assert not c.get("securityContext",{}).get("capabilities",{}).get("add")

CHART_ROOT=''
CHART_FILES=['Chart.yaml', 'values.yaml', 'templates/workload.yaml']
import os, json, subprocess, tempfile, pathlib, re, copy
import yaml
BASE=pathlib.Path.cwd()
HELM=os.environ.get("OPSF_HELM_BIN","helm")
def render(values=None,release="lab",namespace="training",file_overrides=None,lint=False,expect_failure=False,schema_failure=False):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="helm-contract-") as temp:
        chart=pathlib.Path(temp)/"chart";chart.mkdir()
        for name in CHART_FILES:
            relative=pathlib.Path(name).relative_to(CHART_ROOT) if CHART_ROOT else pathlib.Path(name)
            dst=chart/relative;dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            dst.write_text((BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8"),encoding="utf8")
        if values is not None:(chart/"values.yaml").write_text(yaml.safe_dump(values,sort_keys=False),encoding="utf8")
        for name,text in (file_overrides or {}).items():
            target=(chart/name).resolve()
            assert target.is_relative_to(chart.resolve())
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);target.write_text(text,encoding="utf8")
        if lint:
            p=subprocess.run([HELM,"lint",str(chart)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
            assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr+p.stdout
        p=subprocess.run([HELM,"template",release,str(chart),"--namespace",namespace],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
        if expect_failure:
            assert p.returncode!=0,"invalid values unexpectedly rendered"
            if schema_failure:assert "schema" in (p.stdout+p.stderr).lower(),"must reject through schema"
            return p.stderr+p.stdout
        assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr+p.stdout
        docs=[d for d in yaml.safe_load_all(p.stdout) if d is not None]
        assert all(isinstance(d,dict) for d in docs)
        guard_rendered(docs,namespace)
        return docs
def one(docs,kind):
    found=[d for d in docs if d.get("kind")==kind]
    assert len(found)==1,(kind,docs)
    return found[0]

actual_templates={x.as_posix() for x in pathlib.Path("templates").rglob("*") if x.is_file()}
assert actual_templates==expected_templates,"extra/missing template file"

for create,name,release in [(True,"","alpha"),(True,"custom","beta"),(False,"existing","gamma")]:

import yaml

HELM=os.environ.get("OPSF_HELM_BIN","helm")
def render(values=None,release="lab",namespace="training",file_overrides=None,lint=False,expect_failure=False,schema_failure=False):

## 环境与初始材料
网页编辑Helm模板，平台验收器须提供Helm3、Python/PyYAML；离线执行lint/template，不需要云账号或打开集群。

Service始终ClusterIP，port与containerPort分别从values读取，targetPort必须引用容器命名http端口，不能假设二者相等。保持selector和Pod标签一致、镜像固定；本题不配置nginx监听，不能把声明端口当实际监听验证。

- templates/network.yaml：完整修复模板。

Chart.yaml、values.yaml是固定样例；验收会替换多组values，不能硬编码样例。不得新增模板、渲染额外资源、改变题定镜像或训练命名空间。
